input.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
input.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Walmart's total revenues for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased year over year. This would require comparing Q3 FY2027 (ended October 31, 2026) to Q3 FY2026 (ended October 31, 2025).

The evidence provided does not contain financial data for the quarter ended October 31, 2026. The most recent quarterly filing in the evidence is the 10-Q filed on August 28, 2026 for the period ended July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027). The 10-K filed on March 13, 2026 covers the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026.

Evidence E6 shows revenues for quarters ended July 31, 2026 and July 31, 2025, but this is for Q2, not Q3. There is no evidence showing revenues for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 or comparing it to the quarter ended October 31, 2025.

Since the evidence does not cover the specific reporting period (Q3 FY2027 ended October 31, 2026) mentioned in the claim, there is insufficient evidence to verify whether total revenues increased year over year for that quarter.
